content.text:
Role: Expert UI/UX Engineer
Task: Fix the "Decision Memory" page. It currently looks like generic, blocky AI slop. Transform it into a premium, deep-dark-mode, glassmorphic timeline (BMW wet-chrome aesthetic).

Execute these strict CSS/Tailwind changes:

1. The Background:
Remove the current cheap gray/blue gradient. The global background MUST be a deep space charcoal with a subtle top-center radial glow:
bg-[#050508] bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-[#111827] via-[#050508] to-black

2. The Header Area (Destroy the Block):
Remove the massive dark-gray background box behind the "Decision memory" title. The title should float directly on the page background.

Make the title sleeker: text-4xl font-light tracking-tight text-white.

Make the subtitle: text-sm text-gray-400.

3. Search & Export Controls (Glassmorphism):

Search Bar: Make it inset and translucent: bg-black/40 border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md text-sm text-gray-300 rounded-lg. Add a subtle inner shadow.

Export Buttons: Convert from bulky outlines to sleek glass pills: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 text-xs text-gray-300 rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-all.

4. The Timeline (The Core Fix):

The Line: Create a continuous, thin, glowing vertical line on the left side: w-px bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-500/50 via-white/10 to-transparent.

The Nodes (Dots): Make the dots glow using drop-shadows: w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(96,165,250,0.8)].

The Timestamps: Move timestamps to the left of the line, keeping them small and technical: text-xs font-mono text-gray-500.

5. The Timeline Event Cards (Wet Chrome/Glass):
Stop using solid, opaque dark-blue blocks.

Card Container: bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/5 hover:border-white/15 hover:bg-white/[0.04] transition-all rounded-xl p-5 shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)].

Event Meta (e.g., "PROJECT CREATED  PM"): text-[10px] tracking-widest uppercase text-blue-400 font-semibold mb-2.

Event Title: text-lg font-medium text-gray-100.

content.text: The gray-blue background is animated by JavaScript, which would override a CSS-only fix. I’ll remove that animation, apply the charcoal glow, and add a continuous timeline line with translucent cards. This app uses plain CSS, so I’ll translate your Tailwind values directly.

Updated Decision Memory with the charcoal radial background, floating title, glass search/export controls, glowing continuous timeline, and translucent event cards.

Search, exports, and audit details remain functional. All 21 tests and JavaScript syntax checks pass. Visual appearance hasn’t been verified in a browser.
I’ll revert my last styling changes and restore the previous appearance.
